AUTOPROMOTE EDUCATION — Two gears. One clear ratio.

1. Upload the original stage
Workspace → Viral Clip Studio → Choose videos → Open Creator Studio
source.mp4 · 1280×720 · 28 seconds · original offline synthetic narration
The source is a plain stage with sound. It contains no animated teaching diagrams.

2. Keep the whole composition visible
After → Preview quality; Reframe; View options; Sound; Captions
Full; 16:9; Show Everyone; Fit full; main frame off; Rounded off; keep original audio; voice repair off; captions off
Preserve precise drawing relationships and a stable full-frame lesson.

3. Import the editable scaffold
Graphics → Import animated graphics → Import graphics composition…
starter.graphics.json; native text, artwork, masks and motion keys
Static original SVGs become ordinary editable image layers. Existing keys use the canonical Studio animation graph; they are not an external movie.

4. Complete the key deliberately
Motion → Transform keyframes → Target layer → Motion value curve editor → Curve keyframe → Selected motion key value
Driver gear; rotation at 24s = 180; easing linear
A complete 360° driver interval corresponds to an opposite 180° driven interval. Linear interpolation preserves the fixed ratio.

5. Inspect the matching layer or group
Motion → Target layer; Layer geometry & timing; Graphics → Groups where applicable
Driven gear; see the full layer/group table below
Check the relationship between layers, rather than judging one moving part in isolation.

6. Add your own annotation
Graphics → Add title layer → Label; Copy/time/size; Motion → Transform keyframes → Target layer = Predict first → X/Y
Practice label: Predict first; start24s; duration4s; size0.55; width60%; explicitly select Predict first in Target layer; X50 Y84. Remove the practice label before final save.
Graphics selection and Motion target are separate. Confirm the new title before editing X/Y so the technical diagram layers remain fixed.

7. Save, export and reopen
Show media → Project name → Save; Export → Render Final Clip; Show Finished Video; saved project
Unique project name; 720p; 24 fps; original audio; normal local CPU render/download; complete 28s playback; cold reopen
The actual authored graph must supply the final result and restore through normal Studio controls.
